findings.passage: The Save America Act makes sure our elections are fair and secure. By requiring photo ID to vote and proof of citizenship to register, we are taking real measures to retore trust and ensure only U.S. Citizens are casting ballots.

findings.passage: I urge the Senate to do the same in an expedient manner.
findings.note: He urges the Senate to pass the Save America Act, which the release says requires photo ID to cast a ballot, lets mail voters attach a copy of ID, requires documentary proof of citizenship to register, monthly voter-roll checks for noncitizens, and a provisional ballot for voters who lack paperwork on Election Day.
